Rahul Gandhi responds to Elon Musk's comment on Ambani

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi responded to a social media post by Elon Musk, who had commented that "Ambani is India's boss." Musk's post was a reply to a user who asked about "who is the boss in India." Gandhi replied to Musk's post with "Wait till you discover the other guy."
